note: TRUTH SOURCE for every published marketing claim (q-007). The composer reads feature truth from here: a template may only reference a feature whose `status` is `live`. Each `live` feature was verified against origin/main at 6aeb78d and is reachable on the production site. FUTURE LANES MUST UPDATE THIS FILE when a feature ships, changes, or is removed — a stale claim here becomes a false post. The fresh-context review gate cross-checks every `live` entry against www.wcdraft.com; a claim prod does not support is a merge blocker. Licensing: nominative 'World Cup' only, no FIFA marks, 'football' never 'soccer', 'manager' never 'coach', 'Synergy' never 'Chemistry'.

features.headline: Free, in your browser, no download
features.claim: wcdraft is free and runs entirely in your browser — no app, no download, no account needed to play.
hooks: Free, in your browser. No download.
No app store, no install — just open it and draft.
Free to play, nothing to download.
features.verify: Load https://www.wcdraft.com and /play in a fresh browser: the game runs client-side with no paywall and no required sign-in.
features.source: apps/web/app/play/page.tsx; client-side draft + sim (no server gate)

features.headline: Realistic, calibrated match simulation of the real 2026 bracket
features.claim: Your XI plays the real 2026 World Cup bracket — 8 matches through the knockouts — in a calibrated match simulation. A perfect run is 8-0.
hooks: Run the real 2026 bracket — 8 matches, a perfect run is 8-0.
Calibrated match sim, not coin-flips — 8 matches to a perfect 8-0.
Eight matches through the real bracket. Can your XI go 8-0?
features.verify: Complete a draft and Simulate: the run plays a group stage + 5 knockout rounds (8 matches); the share/results screen shows the W-L record and flags a perfect 8-0.

features.headline: 17 spins, one pick each — 16 players + a manager
features.claim: Seventeen spins, one pick on each: sixteen players for your XI and bench, plus one manager.
hooks: 17 spins, one pick each — 16 players and a manager.
Seventeen spins. One pick each. Build the whole XI.
16 players + a manager, one spin at a time.
features.verify: A full draft is exactly 17 spins; the spin log includes a manager pick.

features.headline: Managers are a pick
features.claim: The manager is one of your spins — a real pick that shapes the squad, not a footnote.
hooks: Managers are a pick here — one of your 17 spins.
You draft a manager too. Most games don't let you.
One of your spins is the manager. It matters.
features.verify: During a draft one spin is a manager spin (pickManager); the manager appears on the results/share screen.

features.headline: Era presets — draft across 90+ years of squads
features.claim: Choose your era: All-time, Post-2000, Post-2010, or Modern — drafting across more than ninety years of World Cup squads (1930–2026).
hooks: Four era presets: All-time, Post-2000, Post-2010, Modern.
Draft across 1930–2026, or narrow to one era.
All-time or Modern — you choose the era you draft from.
features.verify: On /play/draft open 'Draft setup' → Era: four selectable presets (All-time, Post-2000, Post-2010, Modern).

features.headline: Two modes — Classic and Memory
features.claim: Play Classic with every rating visible, or Memory mode where ratings stay hidden until you simulate and the reveal becomes the story.
hooks: Classic, or Memory — ratings hidden until the reveal.
Two modes: ratings on the table, or draft from memory.
Memory mode hides the numbers until you simulate.
features.verify: /play offers Classic and Memory cards; Memory mode masks ratings in-draft and reveals them after Simulate.

features.headline: Draft order choice — Squad First or Position First
features.claim: Pick your draft order: Squad First, or Position First — commit a slot to fill before the squad is even revealed.
hooks: Squad First or Position First — your call.
Position First: lock the slot, then spin for who fills it.
Two ways to draft: by squad, or by position.
features.verify: On /play/draft open 'Draft setup' → Draft mode: Squad First / Position First are both selectable.

features.headline: Nation synergy
features.claim: Players from the same nation build Synergy — a live preview shows your XI's connections as you draft.
hooks: Same-nation picks build Synergy — watch it live as you draft.
Nation Synergy rewards a connected XI.
Synergy ticks up when your nations line up.
features.verify: Classic mode shows a live Synergy preview that responds to same-nation picks.

features.headline: Position filters + in-draft search
features.claim: Filter the rolled squad by position and search players by name, right inside the draft.
hooks: Filter by position and search by name — in the draft.
Position filters + search to find your pick fast.
Search the rolled squad by name, filter by position.
features.verify: In-draft: a 'Search players…' input and a position filter (ALL / GK / DF / MF / FW) both work.

features.headline: Season-keyed ranked leaderboard
features.claim: Post your run to a season-keyed ranked leaderboard and see where your XI lands.
hooks: There's a season-keyed leaderboard — post your run.
Ranked board, keyed to the season. Climb it.
Submit your run to the leaderboard and rank up.
features.verify: The leaderboard board page is reachable and accepts a submitted run (LEADERBOARD_ENABLED live in prod).

features.headline: Shareable, replayable run links
features.claim: Every run gets a shareable link that replays the exact same draft and result in any browser — same seed, same outcome.
hooks: Every run has a shareable, replayable link.
Share your run — the link replays it exactly, any browser.
Same seed, same outcome: your run link is fully reproducible.
features.verify: A completed run yields a https://www.wcdraft.com/play/share?run=t2.<token> URL that reproduces the run in a fresh browser.

features.headline: Rating basis — Career (Current coming)
features.claim: Ratings are career-basis today; a Current basis arrives after the rating rebuild.
features.verify: On /play/draft 'Draft setup' → Rating basis: Career is active, Current is DISABLED ('Current arrives after the rating rebuild'). DO NOT pitch a basis CHOICE until Current is enabled in prod.
features.source: apps/web/components/game/draft-screen.tsx (Rating basis segment: Current button disabled)
